title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 04 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. 80 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 20, GA 20, Maths 20, English 20.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC GD Constable latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Clock : Time :: Thermometer : ?
questions.explanation: A clock measures time; a thermometer measures temperature.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If BRAIN is coded as CSBJO, how is HEART coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: H→I, E→F, A→B, R→S, T→U so IFBSU.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. C is the wife of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: C is wife of D, so D is father of B and A. A is son of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 km North, then 6 km East, then 10 km South. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: North and South cancel; he is 6 km East of start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256, 288
questions.explanation: All others are perfect squares (11² to 16²). 288 is not a perfect square.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are papers. Conclusions: I. Some pens are papers. II. Some books are pens.
questions.explanation: All pens are books ⇒ some books are pens. Some books being papers does not force pens to be papers.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P, Q, R, S, T sit in a row facing North. Q sits at one end. R sits second to the right of Q. S sits between R and T. Who sits in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: Q, P, R, S, T (or Q at left). Q end, R second right of Q ⇒ Q _ R. S between R and T ⇒ Q P R S T. Middle is R.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 2: 112 × 2 = 224.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents: Police, Thief, Criminal?
questions.explanation: Every thief is a criminal, but police is a separate set.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: The mirror image of the word 'GUARD' (vertical mirror on the right) will start with which letter appearance?
questions.explanation: Right-side vertical mirror reverses order: last letter D appears first as its mirror form.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not a leap year after 15 Aug 2024, so +1 day: Friday. (From 15 Aug 2024 to 15 Aug 2025 is 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day.)

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: How many times do the hands of a clock coincide in 12 hours?
questions.explanation: Hands coincide 11 times in 12 hours (not at 11–12 and 12–1 separately in that stretch as 12 is shared).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 12th from the left and B is 18th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B from left = 40-18+1=23. Between A (12) and B (23) = 10 students.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All officers are honest. Some honest people are poor. Conclusion: Some officers are poor.
questions.explanation: The poor honest people need not include officers. Conclusion does not follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A cube is painted red on all faces and cut into 27 smaller equal cubes. How many small cubes have only one face painted?
questions.explanation: 3×3×3 cube: each of 6 faces has 1 centre cube with only one face painted.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the next letters: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letters A,B,C,D,E; second letters Z,Y,X,W,V → EV.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a square paper is folded twice and two holes are punched, the maximum number of holes after unfolding can be:
questions.explanation: Two folds create 4 layers; 2 punches × 4 layers = 8 holes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means ×, × means −, − means ÷ and ÷ means +, then 8 ÷ 2 + 3 − 6 × 1 = ?
questions.explanation: After replacement the expression becomes 8 + 2 × 3 ÷ 6 − 1. Using BODMAS: 2 × 3 = 6, 6 ÷ 6 = 1, then 8 + 1 − 1 = 8.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Six people A B C D E F sit around a circular table facing centre. A sits opposite D. B sits to the immediate right of A. C sits between B and D. Who sits opposite C?
questions.explanation: C between B and D on one arc; E and F occupy remaining two seats, so opposite of C can be E or F depending on exact placement. Data insufficient.
